files.description: Club members, one per row (240 rows): member_id (whole number), full_name (first and last name; many names have accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent), home_city (city name, several with accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent; about 3% of cells are empty and about 3% hold "-" for an unknown city), fee (yearly fee, two decimals).

task_text: Convert the members file into JSON text: a list with one JSON record per member, holding the keys member_id, full_name, home_city and fee, in file order. A city that is empty or '-' must appear as JSON null; all other values stay as they are. `result` should be that JSON text (a string).
intended_computation: Build one record per member (240 records, file order) with member_id, full_name and fee unchanged and home_city unchanged except that empty cells and '-' become null, and serialise the list as JSON text.

acceptable_variants.notes: whitespace and key order inside the JSON text, and escaping of non-ASCII letters, may differ; fee and member_id may be JSON numbers (fee 104.5, 104.50, 150 or 150.0) or the text as written in the file ('104.50')

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the None written into the text column is stored as NaN, so the JSON text contains NaN instead of null (invalid JSON)

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
